findings.title: Unchecked internal balance update permits fake double spend
findings.root_cause: The fake vault updates an account balance after a simulated external transfer instead of before it.
findings.impact: A caller in this synthetic example can repeat the withdrawal path and drain fake accounting balances.
findings.proof_sketch: Call deposit once, invoke withdraw through the fake callback path twice, and observe the stored balance remains available for the second withdrawal.
reproduction_steps: Deposit a synthetic balance for the test account.
Trigger the callback path during withdrawal and repeat the call.
